text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah... The new issue...
It arrived after all... Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusumes
text_block_list.text:
—Haha, that's hilarious! Are you seriously saying that?
—If it were me, I'd go home in a heartbeat~!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: My, what a loud voice...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, if you could please
keep your voices down a little...?"

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusumes
text_block_list.text:
“—And then, an unexpected twist happened!
—Whoa! Now I really wanna know what happens next~~!”

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...I am terribly sorry.
Could you perhaps lower your voice just a bit...?

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusumes
text_block_list.text:
—Ahaha, that's hilarious~!
—So, what really happened when you got caught?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: (It's no use... It's just like always, no one notices me...)

Entering the library, Still in Love flustered
and panicking caught my eye.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Um... the people over there
are being quite noisy...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I tried asking them if they could keep their voices down,
but they didn't seem to notice me...

Looking over, several Umamusume were chatting happily
around the study desks. They didn't seem to realize
how much their voices were echoing.
choice_data_list: Then I'll go ask for a quick favor.
Then I'll go ask them real quick.

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusumes
text_block_list.text:
—Hey, hey, what happened after that?
—I totally would've cracked up right there~~!
choice_data_list: Um, could you be a little quieter?
Um, could you keep it down a bit?

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh? Huh? Who are you?
Would you mind not interrupting our conversation?"
choice_data_list: Your voices were really carrying, so...
Because your voices were really carrying...

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
You're so persistent. If it bothers you that much,
why don't you just go somewhere quiet yourself?
One of them waved their arm in irritation. Their elbow brushed lightly against me, making me instinctively step back.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Please... don't lay a hand... on that person...

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Huh? Did someone just say something?

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Wasn't me. Anyway, where did that come from...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...I told you...
"not to raise your hand"...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"That person is... to me...
a very, very precious person..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"I will never... ever permit anyone
to look down on that person...—"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I will N-E-V-E-R forgive this...!!

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusumes
text_block_list.text:
“—Who's this guy? Showing up out of nowhere, it's creepy...
—L-Let's just get out of here...!”
The Umamusume left the library with hesitant, puzzled looks.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
—...Trainer-san...!
Are you hurt...!?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...I'm so, so glad...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Um, before I knew it, I... I stepped forward... My heart feels like it's about to burst...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
That's why... called out like that...
—...gh.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Doing something like that... right in front of you, Trainer...

Still in Love suddenly ran off.
Without understanding why, you chased after her—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Because...
it's so, so pathetic...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Seeing her... totally consumed by rage like that...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...The thought that... you might get hurt...
was so painful to bear...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
My mind was... completely consumed by...
'I have to protect them'...!"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I really didn't want Trainer...
to see me like that...
choice_data_list: I'm happy you care that much about it.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Trainer...?
choice_data_list: So please, don't put yourself down like that.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Those words are far too kind for someone like me...
...And yet...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I was able to protect you...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
That at least...
might be something I can take pride in...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...When you put it that way...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...I'm a little embarrassed...

Still in Love gave a slight nod.
...Her cheeks quietly, yet undeniably, flushed with color.
